profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Graduate of Penn State with a Masters degree in Software Engineering. Currently working as a Senior Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin. I am interested in software development, DevSecOps and CI/CD, as well as positions where I can apply my knowledge and experience to advance the mission and provide value for the customer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
•	Provided great and friendly service to customers while maintaining speed and accuracy
•	Adapted to unplanned situations quickly, and assisted in various departments as needed
•	Used communication skills to meet customer’s needs and work with team members

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked with the Capture Pro software team
•	Performed competitive benchmarking tests on Capture Pro and other competing software products.
•	Collaborated with members of the team in Rochester and in Germany
•	Compiled a detailed list of findings for future marketing
